title: Application of Deep Learning on the Prognosis of Cutaneous Melanoma Based on Full Scan Pathology Images
summary: Original Methods/Results report a retrospective clinical prognosis-classification study using VGG-19 on full-scan melanoma pathology images from CPTAC-CM, comparing prognosis groups. This is a specific clinical prognostic-validation result; interpret as preliminary retrospective model performance, not clinical benefit.
organization: Not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.ai_role: Cohort: 53 melanoma patients with known survival status (12 deceased, 41 living); VGG-19 image classification; random patient/image split details are imperfectly described, 5-fold CV; mean AUC 0.769±0.037, while SVM deep-feature AUC is 0.65. The source supports a bounded retrospective prognostic result and explicitly says performance is not yet satisfactory.
